title: Spicy Thai Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful Thai-inspired noodle soup made with chicken, noodles, and a spicy kick.

ingredients.name: light coconut milk
ingredients.notes: full-fat or low-fat, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: optional, for added depth of flavor

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.notes: optional, to balance out the heat

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the curry paste to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the chicken broth, coconut milk, fish sauce, and sugar.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the pot and cook until heated through.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with chopped cilantro.
